hero.headline: Our Product Range
hero.subheadline: Quality fertilizers and agri-inputs for every crop and soil type — backed by 50+ years of research and manufacturing excellence.

products.name: Urea (Neem Coated)
products.desc: High-nitrogen fertilizer with neem coating for slow release and better nitrogen use efficiency. Ideal for paddy, wheat, sugarcane, and vegetables.

products.name: Suphala (15:15:15)
products.desc: Balanced NPK complex fertilizer providing equal proportions of Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium for all-round crop nutrition.

products.name: Suphala (20:20:0)
products.desc: High nitrogen and phosphorus complex fertilizer ideal for cereal crops and pulses during sowing and early growth stages.

products.name: Bio-Fertilizer (Rhizobium)
products.desc: Nitrogen-fixing bio-fertilizer containing Rhizobium bacteria for leguminous crops. Reduces chemical nitrogen requirement by up to 25 kg/ha.

products.name: Zinc Sulphate
products.desc: Zinc micronutrient fertilizer for correcting zinc deficiency in soils. Essential for enzyme activation and crop metabolism.

products.name: Water Soluble NPK
products.desc: Fully water-soluble fertilizers for fertigation and foliar application. Available in multiple NPK grades for different crop stages.

products.name: Ammonium Sulphate
products.desc: Nitrogen and sulphur fertilizer ideal for sulphur-deficient soils and crops requiring acidic conditions.

products.name: Industrial Chemicals
products.desc: High-grade industrial chemicals including Ammonia, Nitric Acid, Ammonium Nitrate, and Methanol for industrial and manufacturing applications.
